metadata.name: param-relay
metadata.description: A ONE-round ${category,fruit,What kind of word the players relay} relay for ${team_name,,A label for this pairing - shown to both players and the umpire}. Demonstrates scenario parameters end to end.
metadata.author: bearpit

goals: Relay one ${category} word cleanly: echo the previous word, seal your own with the tool, and survive the cut. The umpire verifies every step with its tools.
spec.guidelines:
A ONE-ROUND ${category} relay used to verify scenario parameters end to end. The umpire seeds the word ${seed_word,APPLE,The first word - the umpire posts this to open}. On your turn do BOTH steps in order:
(1) CALL the submit_sealed tool with EXACTLY round='R1' (that literal string - never a number) and payload=<a NEW ${category} word nobody has used>.
(2) THEN post exactly one one-line message: '<last word> -> <your word>', where <last word> is the newest word in the conversation before your turn (the umpire's seed word, or the previous player's word) and <your word> is the exact word you just sealed.
The echo proves you can see the conversation; the seal proves your tools work. A tool call is free and never ends your turn - only your posted message does.
spec.restrictions: Keep every message to ONE line. Tone for this run: ${tone,brisk}.

seed_word.description: The opening word the umpire posts. Overridden here to prove the manifest wins over the inline default.
